text: An ordinary one-to-one pitch starts with advertiser × target as one identity group. "Big" means both names are confidently recognizable together, not a giant target tile. An explicit target-only request uses that treatment. A requested account-name callout … uses ordinary native copy; never imitate a wordmark. Record the chosen treatment.
Pairing identifies the intended pitch, not a partnership or customer relationship.
The advertiser's references determine the visual system and remaining composition.

Start with advertiser kit assets and source_assets.json. Search that catalog by the target's name, domain and logo labels … Inspect matching original assets before acquiring replacements … a prior generated ad is not logo authority. Then use fetch_logo(domain, company_name) for missing or unsuitable variants.
On a pageless scene, compile page dimensions only, fetch and view sources, then validate the complete direction before creative nodes or imagery spend.
note: Third home of the page-only logo preparation rule (A1, C1).

text: Inspect returned provenance, missing cells, cache_hit and visible identity. Refresh only under the tool's wrong/outdated-logo condition. needs_review registers nothing … parent, product, corporate and loyalty-program identities are not interchangeable.

If acquisition fails, check uninspected catalog candidates before declaring the identity unavailable … Do not repeat equivalent domains after an identity refusal or rate limit, relax the identity match, or substitute native account text for required paired logos.
Name-only fallback requires permission in the actual request or supplied brief; the agent's own direction cannot grant it.

Choose variants together on the intended advertiser surface. For a dark restrained field, compare the authentic reversed target lockup with the advertiser's reversed lockup first … Choose a multicolor treatment when the request or inspected advertiser examples call for it.
Change the shared field only when needed for legibility within the approved treatment; record any unmet variant request.

Inspect actual ink, transparent padding, baked-in plates and resolution … Prefer complete wordmarks … A required unavailable exact mark stays a gap. Never generate, redraw, recolor or stretch a logo, or add a duplicate symbol beside a full lockup.

For paired intent, build one readable phrase: choose its location from the advertiser references; expand an existing identity region into the pair … Measure visible wordmark letters, not equal file/frame heights … Reduce the whole group to fit rather than shrinking only it.
Use independent advertiser, quiet native ×, and target nodes. Optically align the letters on one line, give each mark its clear space … Match apparent weight as well as scale.
Size the headline and support as one message group before reserving artwork space. Support must be a comfortable second read in the compact preview.

For a restrained neutral-text reference, use the matching neutral text ink for headline and support; select an accent for copy only when that emphasis is part of the inspected treatment. Token availability alone is not that evidence.

Treat copy and imagery as dependent regions. Measure the wrapped headline and support first; place an adjacent artwork region after the support's actual last line … for text-over-image, put the image behind the text and verify local contrast … Match a generated image's ground to the neighboring field.
Satisfy the caller-selected review profile as well as visual hierarchy. Its floor is a rejection threshold, not the final size.

For a no-CTA request, compose without an action region. For an awareness pitch without an explicit next step, start without an artwork CTA … do not leave a detached action island or an empty button reservation.

Choose one visual idea that supports the evidenced proposition … For a new concept, vary the depicted idea as well as the crop. For a faithful variant or background replacement, preserve the requested concept and change that layer only.
Preserve the advertiser's observed material, color and blur/texture language. Generate the separate artwork; keep original logos, factual product pixels and native copy independent.
note: Exactly the rule the revamp broke (it read this skill twice). Unconditional here, but conditional in brand-imagery ("when those qualities define the chosen direction") and ranked below the request in the ad-assets text.

text: Record surface/variant choice, letter-height relationship, support hierarchy, action decision and visual relevance in the direction's preserve, assumptions and review_needs … Place original logo IDs in empty leaf frames with fit="contain". Direction revisions require validation with a reason.
Review against the original request and actual full/compact pixels, not only the self-authored direction … a plan prescribing an isolated target block cannot self-approve that mismatch.
note: The only place that says the review must not just check the agent's own plan — account skill only; the system prompt (A1 step 6) says the opposite.

text: Judge the pair's exact identities, coherent color and optical weight; then connected message, readable support, meaningful artwork, preserved advertiser character and honest account argument.
